title: The Crimson Cipher
description: Lord Harrington lies dead in his study. Spend leads wisely, link evidence on the board, and prove who wrote the bloody cipher.
intro: October 1889. The Harrington manor is sealed. Scotland Yard wants answers before dawn.

clue-1.title: Police Report
clue-1.content: Victim: Lord Harrington. Found dead in his study at 11:00 PM. The window latch was broken from the inside. A crimson cipher on the wall reads: 'THE RAVEN FLIES AT MIDNIGHT'.

clue-2.title: Suspect: Arthur Penhaligon
clue-2.content: The victim's nephew and heir. Claims he was at the Grand Theater until midnight. Known to gamble heavily.

clue-3.title: Theater Ticket Stub
clue-3.content: A torn ticket for 'The Raven' at the Grand Theater, stamped 10:30 PM. Found folded inside Arthur's overcoat pocket.

clue-4.title: Cipher Connection
clue-4.content: 'The Raven' is both the play Arthur attended and the phrase in the cipher. Arthur had opportunity and a motive tied to the message.

clue-5.title: Debt Ledger
clue-5.content: Harrington's private ledger shows Arthur owed £4,000 due by week's end. A note reads: 'Tell no one or you inherit nothing.'

clue-6.title: Motive & Means
clue-6.content: Arthur needed the inheritance immediately. The broken inside latch suggests someone the lord trusted was already in the house.

combinations.message: The play title matches the cipher. Arthur is no mere witness.

challenge.prompt: What links the cipher to Arthur?

options.text: 'The Raven' is the play on his ticket stub
The housekeeper's keys match the broken latch
The doctor altered the time of death

combinations.message: Motive and opportunity align. Time to make an accusation.

challenge.prompt: Why is Arthur the prime suspect?

options.text: Debt, cipher link, and trusted access to the house
Elena argued with the lord at 10 PM
Dr. Crane signed the certificate too quickly

suspects.name: Arthur Penhaligon
suspects.detail: Gambling debts, shaky alibi, found near the study earlier that evening.

suspects.name: Elena Voss
suspects.detail: Heard arguing with the lord at 10 PM. Has keys to every room.

suspects.name: Dr. Reginald Crane
suspects.detail: Signed the death certificate quickly. Was treating Harrington for heart trouble.

solution.explanation: Arthur Penhaligon forged a theater alibi while leaving the cipher from 'The Raven'. Crushing debt gave him motive; his familiarity with the house explains the inside latch.
solution.redHerringNote: Elena had keys and argued with the lord, but the cipher points to the play Arthur attended—not the servants' quarters.
